overview_description.description:
Viz helps physicians to identify anomalies in brain scans through machine learning. The company leverages advanced deep learning to communicate time-sensitive information about stroke patients straight to a specialist who can intervene and treat them. It uses deep learning algorithms to identify a suspected large vessel occlusion, a particularly disabling type of stroke, in a CT scan and alerts the stroke team specialist within minutes.

Viz has developed deep learning algorithms to analyze brain scans for large vessel occlusions (LVOs), a disabling type of stroke. The company also allows the stroke center’s clinicians to rapidly share images back and forth. Viz's mission is to fundamentally improve how healthcare is delivered in the world, through intelligent software that promises to reduce the time to treatment and improve access to care.

Viz was founded in 2016 and is based in San Francisco, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Viz is a medical imaging company that provides an AI-based care coordination tool for disease detection and workflow optimization.

product.name: Viz.ai One
product.description: An AI-powered care coordination platform that analyzes medical imaging and other clinical data, detects suspected disease, and connects care teams to accelerate diagnosis, referral, and treatment.

product.name: Viz Assist
product.description: A multimodal AI agent platform and workflow assistant designed to help healthcare teams interpret clinical information, coordinate tasks, and support faster treatment decisions.

product.name: Viz Neuro Suite
product.description: A suite of AI and care coordination tools for detecting and managing suspected neurovascular conditions, including stroke, hemorrhage, aneurysm, and post-acute stroke care.

product.name: Viz Cardio Suite
product.description: An AI-powered cardiovascular care suite that supports detection and workflow coordination for conditions such as hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and acute coronary syndrome.

product.name: Viz Vascular Suite
product.description: A vascular medicine care coordination suite that uses AI to detect suspected pulmonary embolism and aortic disease and activate appropriate clinical workflows.

product.name: Viz Radiology Suite
product.description: An AI-supported radiology workflow suite that helps detect suspected abnormalities, prioritize cases, and provide automated assessments for faster diagnosis and treatment decisions.
